guard.cleanup_boundary: owned group, observed descendants, and inherited marker with three empty sweeps spanning50ms; trusted toolchain must preserve marker; polling is not atomic or hostile-process containment
guard.rss_scope: live union of current ancestry, retained PID/birth identities and periodic inherited-marker matches; sampled, not a kernel quota
